BJP alleges Rahul Gandhi pushed pregnant journalist

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has accused Congress leader Rahul Gandhi of pushing a pregnant woman journalist and causing her injury. The party also alleged that Gandhi elbowed one of his own party workers. According to the BJP, the journalist's condition is serious and she has been hospitalized. The party stated that Gandhi's behavior is undemocratic.
